rows.text: S.O. 1205(E) of 24 July 2007 [F. No. 2/4/2007-Public], signed by Madhukar Gupta, Secretary, notifies that the ceremony of assumption of office of the President by Smt. Pratibha Devisingh Patil, the President-elect, will take place at 2.30 PM on Wednesday, 25 July 2007 in the Central Hall of Parliament House, and that the oath of office will be taken by the President-elect in the presence of the Chief Justice of India as prescribed under Article 60, followed by a 21-gun salute and an address.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Prime Minister, the Vice-President (including any service as acting President), ministers and party offices are excluded.
